Name: Barking Dog for Alternative Textures
Author: ch0opera
Description:
[color=#b4a7d6][i]* [/i][4/5/23] - [i]A new Barking Dog has been unleashed. [/i][i]🐾 *

[/i][/color][font=Arial][color=#9fc5e8][b][size=3]⚞ Seventy percent of all earned DP goes to the Wildlife Conservation Society [/size][size=5]🐾[/size][size=3] ⚟[/size][/b][/color][/font]

[line][i][b][size=4]What's this?[/size][/b][/i]
[font=Arial][size=3]A simple AT pack for your dog inspired by the "Barking Dog" design by American artist Keith Haring[/size]

[/font][size=4][b][i]Is that all?[/i][/b][/size]
[size=3]Yep. [/size] 
[b]
[/b][b][size=4][i]How do I do it?[/i][/size][/b]
[size=3]> Make sure you have the latest version of Alternative Textures installed (this mod is a content pack for AT). [/size]
[size=3]> Install this mod. [/size]
[size=3]> Use the AT Scissors tool to retexture your animal. If you're unfamiliar with AT, check out their [/size][b][url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki]wiki[/url]﻿ [/b][size=3]for a helpful, in-depth guide. [/size]
[size=3]> [i]Optionally[/i], you can also use the Barking Dog sprite sheet with Adopt 'n' Skin or Cats and Dogs mods. Just rename the png with the proper AnS naming format for skins (probably something like "dog_#.png"). [/size]
[size=4][b]
[/b][b][i]What is the [/i]Barking Dog[i]?
[/i][/b][/size][spoiler]
[size=3]The Barking Dog is one of Haring's most popular symbols. Check it out in Images. You can read more about it and Keith Haring below. They'll explain things better than I can!
[/size]
[quote][font=Georgia][size=2]Keith Haring’s dog motifs began to appear in his subway drawing series from 1980-1985. During this time, he would draw on matte black paper with white chalk, posting them over expired subway advertisements. Haring is known for wanting to create work that was accessible and enjoyable to as many as possible instead of the select few who could afford it, and his subway drawing paved the way for art accessibility. None of his works in his [i]Subway Drawings[/i] are titled, ensuring that each person could create their own interpretation rather than having their view influenced subliminally by Haring’s intention.[/size][/font][/quote]
[url=https://news.masterworksfineart.com/2022/07/07/keith-haring-dogs]Haring Dogs[/url] (^ source ^)
[url=https://www.tate.org.uk/art/art-terms/g/graffiti-art/five-things-know-keith-haring]Five Things to Know: Keith Haring (tate.org.uk)[/url] ﻿- this is a great 4-min video about the artist. Worth a watch for fans and those unfamiliar alike :)
[/spoiler]

﻿[b][size=4][i]Why is [/i]Barking Dog[i]? [/i][/size][/b]
[size=3]I thought it would be fun to have a flatter, graffiti-style dog in the beautiful world of Stardew Valley. [/size]
[size=3]I tried my best. If it doesn't look _aesthetic_ at least your dog will stand out! xD (Actually, I think it looks pretty good!)
[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][b][font=Arial][line][size=4]
[center][/center][/size][/font][/b][/color][center][color=#b4a7d6][b][font=Arial][size=5]Praise for Barking Dog. . .[/size]
[/font][/b][/color][size=3][font=Arial]
"A rather messy and charming sort of style." — Spritework Renovations Inc.

"...the blank faces...they need eyes." — Coastal Spelunkers Coalition

"Why does that exist D:" — Bespoke Events Catering

"It's honestly pretty darn cute!" — Prismatic Opposum Poet

"Oh my fucking god I LOVE that dog." — Pop Art Collective[/font][/size][/center][size=3][center][font=Arial][/font][/center][/size]
